summary: First-finish smoke test of CT-e Painel. Backend (11 endpoint checks) and frontend (full record creation flow) both work end-to-end. One minor UX quirk in payment value parsing.
passed: GET /api/cnpj/33000167000101 -> 200, razao_social='PETROLEO BRASILEIRO S A PETROBRAS'
GET /api/cnpj with 13 digits -> 400 'CNPJ deve conter 14 dígitos'
POST /api/uploads PNG -> 200 with {id, storage_path, original_filename, content_type, size}
GET /api/files/{id} -> 200 image/png (Emergent Object Storage integration working)
Frontend: Dashboard loads, CNPJ mask + auto-fill of razão social works (BrasilAPI badge visible)
Frontend: CT-e prominent banner shows number + Copiar button
Frontend: Receipt dropzone accepts PNG, receipt-file-item rendered, counter updates
Frontend: Submit creates row in records-table with company + BRL value + receipts count
Frontend: records-search-input filters by CNPJ substring

failed.issue: Payment value input parses '2500.75' as 250075 -> displays 'R$ 250.075,00'. In pt-BR the decimal separator is ',' but the input does not treat '.' as decimal, effectively multiplying by 100 when user types with a dot.
failed.evidence: Typed '2500.75', on blur field showed 'R$ 250.075,00' and record was persisted with payment_value reflecting that. Screenshot: .screenshots/after_submit.png

action_items: Consider normalizing payment_value input: accept both '.' and ',' as decimal separator, or strip formatting before parseFloat so 2500.75 stays R$ 2.500,75.
